headline: $160,000 Jean Arp Sculpture Swiped from Art Cologne Booth
summary: A bronze sculpture by renowned French German artist Hans (Jean) Arp valued at €145,000 ($160,000) was stolen from Galerie Ludorff’s booth at Art Cologne on November 8, the last day of the fair’s run. Maya Hanke, Galerie Ludorff’s publicist and art fair manager told the platform that the fair’s security measures were inadequate. Fair representative Judith Leyendecker told the publication that fair officials were in contact with the gallery and were supporting the police investigation.
